title: Address PR #95 review: feats fail-closed fix
description: Review feedback on PR #95 (loreweaver-0m9.5.5). Blocking: feats section anchor missing requireEndHeading:true. Tests needed: fail-closed regression, exact-keys assertion. Optional: Unicode cleanup. Review source: user message in session.
close_reason: All review items evaluated and implemented. requireEndHeading:true added to feats anchor, regression test added, exact-keys assertion added, decorative Unicode cleaned up in comments.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Review item 1 (blocking): requireEndHeading:true missing from feats anchor. ACCEPTED — verified sections.ts lines 183-187: feats anchor has endHeading but no requireEndHeading:true. The endHeading already covers 'Appendix A: Conditions' via ^Appendix\b, so adding requireEndHeading:true is safe with the current happy-path fixture order (FEATS_PAGE -> CONDITIONS_PAGE).

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Review item 2: fail-closed regression test. ACCEPTED — will add pipeline test using fixture [SPELL_LISTS, SPELLS, MONSTERS, CONDITIONS, FEATS_WITH_NO_END]. Slice order in index.ts is: spellDescriptions -> spellLists -> conditions -> feats. conditions slices successfully (requireEndHeading:false), then feats throws SectionNotFoundError('end',...). Test expects /end heading not found/.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Review item 3: exact feat keys assertion. ACCEPTED — current test uses toContain('feat:grappler') + toHaveLength(5) which is unambiguous but implicit. Will add explicit featKeys filter + toEqual(['feat:grappler']) for clarity.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Review item 4 (optional): Unicode cleanup. PARTIAL — U+2022 bullet/U+2014 em-dash/U+2264/U+2192 found in parseFeats.ts comments and test files. Not bidirectional control characters so no security warning. Will replace decorative chars in parseFeats.ts comments (U+2264 -> <=, U+2014 -> -). Bullet U+2022 in regexes kept as •. Bullets in test fixture strings kept as-is (functional, test bullet-stripping logic; consistent with parseConditions.test.ts). Em-dashes in describe() strings kept (consistent existing test style).
